title: Chapter 883
paragraphs: Chapter 883
Episode 220. Never Tiring (5)
"Huff...!"
Suddenly!
Syris summoned the Ice Bing reflexively as he rose.
"Whoa, you startled me! Hey, Ice Princess. Put the Ice Bing away, it suddenly got cold in here and I'm in pain!"
"You're awake, Syris."
Syris looked around, startled by the unexpected voices of Murakan and Gilly. She saw the unfamiliar scene of a special ward in the Tikan Palace.
'Ah... I passed out after killing those guys with Oh's Hundred. Has my body fully recovered? The wounds were pretty deep.'
The wound that had penetrated her shoulder had completely healed without even leaving a scar. It was the same with all kinds of fractures, abrasions, and bruises.
"Oh, you're awake. Young Palace Master, it's Ganggol. Recovering from such injuries in just three days and standing up."
It was Luna.
"...Three days? Was I out for three days?"

"Don't worry, there were no major issues in the Secret Palace or the alliance in the meantime. The King of the Castle said that, even though he personally treated you, the recovery is so fast that it's the first time since our youngest. You've never been injured to this extent, have you? You probably didn't know how sturdy you were. You really are the same kind as me."
"Huh, you're saying that again. The Great Generals I faced were nothing compared to the one you slaughtered."
"Haha, well... hmm, I'm stronger, right? Oh, is that not very comforting?"
"Would it be?"
"But if you fight those Great Generals again, you should be able to win much more easily, right? That would be comforting."
Growth from a life-and-death battle.
Syris did not deny Luna's words.
The sharp sensation of unfolding Oh's Hundred still stirred her mind, and her body, which had just woken up, felt lighter and stronger than ever before.
Soon, Syris shook her head to clear her mind and recognized the smell of the battlefield coming from Luna.
"While I was down, did you go to battle again, First Flagbearer?"

"Yeah, I couldn't rest. The situation is that the formation of the cracks is rapidly increasing now. In the sea garrison, Demon King-class demons keep popping out and putting pressure on the ground, so we're constantly going to the battlefield because of it."

The invasion from the demon world was growing crazier by the day. If we hadn't completed the golden ship in time, if we hadn't been able to build a sea barrier through it, a third of Huphester would have already turned into hell.
We can't protect the whole continent with just the power of the superhumans and our troops.
Currently, a massive battle was constantly unfolding between the barrier set up by the Vamel alliance at sea and the demons.
The Vamel alliance has never lost, leading with the golden ship, but the biggest problem was that the forces of the demon world were not decreasing, but rather increasing day by day.
Jin still insisted that a 'preemptive strike' was the most important. After all, pests will keep crawling out until we find and eradicate their source.

"And since we couldn't use the Mort until today, our preemptive strike mission has been virtually at a standstill. Jin had to move around a lot, so I couldn't ride the Red Owl every time. You know what I mean, right? Get ready. Another garrison has appeared in Kikaro, which we had just beaten up."
"In Kikaro, another one appeared?"

"It seems like many Demon Kings like Jikalro were also summoned. If the Young Palace Master had laid down for just two more hours, I would have had to go alone. It won't be lonely. Here, eat this special sandwich that Ratri made. We're going to leave right after we eat."
"Understood."
"Good, good. Both Luna and the Ice Princess should eat quickly and go. Murakan here will need to rest a bit more with the strawberry pie."
"Don't call me Ice Princess."
"Murakan, you seem upset. Why don't you give me a nickname?"
"Are you upset? I'll call you Sturdy from now on. Sturdy, tell the kid to behave, I'm not really playing around. As soon as I recover, I'll head straight to the battlefield."
"I'm always saying 'how can Murakan laze around like this' to the youngest, but in fact, he worries a lot. Even though he knows."
"Tsk, I don't know. I think that guy doesn't like me dating Strawberry Pie."
"It's normal for any child not to want to see their parents' displays of affection. But Gilly, have you officially become lovers with Murakan now?"
"That's news to me, First Flagbearer."
"Wha, what? Strawberry Pie?"
Syris quickly finished his sandwich.
Surely, if he goes to the battlefield with Luna now, he'll have to risk his life again. It was a fear, but not an unpleasant fear.
"Let's go, First Flagbearer."
[Boooong!]
As the white dimensional door opened, the Mort started running through the different dimensional snowfield.
"Do you still dislike unmanned delivery? Dr. Quaul should hurry up and complete the mass production of Red Owls."
"No, it's not just delivery. Well... Even if it's just delivery, if that's my role, I should be faithful to it."
"Not only your abilities but your inner strength has grown as well."
"Anyway, are you okay?"
"What do you mean?"
"I mean that red energy. I heard there is a limit to its use... You've been using it almost every day since the war started."
"Ah, that. I'm not really sure myself."
"What?"

"My father did tell me to limit its use as much as possible before I become a Creator... Actually, until the Jikalro battle, I did feel a bit worn out when I used it consecutively. But when I killed Jikalro this time, I used a particularly large amount of red sword energy, and instead of feeling exhausted, I was strangely invigorated?"
"Invi...invigorated?"
"Yeah, it felt like impurities were leaving my body."
"Isn't that rather a sign of a more dangerous state?"

"I have been constantly worrying about that. But no matter how much I think about it, I don't feel like it's dangerous. I guess my father also felt like this when he overcame his demonic transformation."
"Hmm."

"Of course, if I start to feel like it's straining my body again, I will try to limit its use as much as possible. Then, the Young Palace Master will have to play a larger role. We've seen in this battle that you also have a power to erase demons like my red sword energy."
[Booo.]
Mort got out of the different dimensional snowfield. We arrived at Kikaro Kingdom in an instant.
There was no trace of the battle Luna and Syris fought here four days ago. A new castle was summoned in the ruined garrison, and an even stronger magic energy was eroding the entire plain.
"It looks like there are almost no unnecessary lower rank troops like last time. And this time, it seems they've filled it entirely with Demon Kings without including any great generals?"
Luna exchanged a glance with Syris, smiling slyly.
"It's just good experience points."
"Great attitude. But they should have gotten rid of the castle along with the troops. Do these guys have surplus resources?"
Chuk!
Luna lifted up Krantel. Just like the last time, she was planning to start by destroying the castle with the final weapon.
But this time, the Demon Kings showed themselves outside the castle first.

"Ah, you're trying to start crudely again. Hey, Luna Runcandel, it would be better not to destroy Misol's castle. Although our Misol isn't good at speaking, she absolutely cannot tolerate her castle being destroyed."
Three Demon Kings, excluding Misol, were coming out of the castle gate. Luna shrugged as she looked them over.

"Really? Why did you bring something so precious as a hostage? Ah, do you want it to be with you when you die? Or are you the type who can only show your true abilities when something precious is broken?"
"Call it the latter. I'm Vice Skaro, the ruler of the deep-sea area of the True Demon Realm."
"I'm Tilius."
"I'm Kukan Ten... I've come to avenge Sikkan, who was killed by a piece of filth from Bigong."
"Sikkan? One of the generals who died four days ago, I see. Good. Sovereign, this time, you take care of that Kukan. It seems he's after you, too."
Kukan appeared to be a powerhouse, incomparable to Villagul or Sikkan. Syris nodded quietly.

'The Sovereign is becoming cuter the more I see. But that guy is still too much for the Sovereign... We'll have to deal with the others first, and once the Sovereign has gained some understanding and is about to die, we'll need to rescue him.'
Of course, if Syris unleashed more potential than Luna expected, it wouldn't be impossible, but Luna was sure she had a new trick up her sleeve, different from the time with Jikalro.

'The purpose of a preemptive attack is to drain the flesh of Zito. But Jikalro did not use the flesh. The True Demon Realm guys won't be stupid either, they'll have increased their numbers this time and each of them will have a piece of Zito's flesh. If Kukan fights against the Sovereign and uses Zito's flesh, there's no way for the Sovereign.'
Luna focused her energy back into the axe-sword Krantel.
"The proclamation and targeting are over. The other three besides Kukan, come at once. Jikalro had some dignity until the end, I wonder about you guys."
Naturally, Luna expected the Demon Kings to hide their trump cards and engage in the battle.
However, her expectations were off from the start. The Demon Kings simultaneously pulled out Zito's flesh from their possession.
Crunch-!
As the Demon Kings gripped the flesh, Luna and Syris were suddenly confronted with a vision that had turned entirely purple.
The power of Zito contained in the flesh being absorbed by the Demon Kings was enough to make Luna and Syris feel a pressure that tingled their skin.
"Did you think we'd let Kukan and the Sovereign fight separately? We're not like Jikalro who cared about decorum."
"Sovereign, change of plan. Ride Mort and exit the battlefield immediately. This time, I should have come alone..."
Syris immediately nodded without arguing or showing a hint of injured pride like before.
However, the dimensional door to the different dimensional snowfield, where Mort could be summoned, did not open. Vice saw Syris' flustered face and smiled slyly.
"Don't think about running away, both of you will fall into the deepest abyss of hell today."
The ground where Luna and Syris stood was already filling with dark water. Vice's deep-sea ability was seen fully submerging both of them in water in just a few seconds.
